reporting.confidence_intervals: Supplied descriptive 95% bootstrap intervals; no bootstrap rerun or endpoint averaging.
reporting.precision: Numeric records are unrounded CSV values; input_records preserves every original decimal string exactly.
reporting.sampling: Accuracy weights sources equally and sampling units equally within each source; requests and seeds are not independent sampling units.
reporting.seed_means: Seed means average two separately evaluated adapters (seeds 17 and 29), not ensembles; latency is the arithmetic mean of their measured means.
reporting.timing: Warm batch-one next-answer request timing uses 128 requests, five repeats, two warmups, and four H100s; it includes fresh input preparation, cached-plan lookup, compression/correction, forward execution, synchronization, and scoring. No image features, hidden states, or answers are reused. Timing values are means only: the CSVs supply no timing confidence intervals. These are not long-answer generation or throughput measurements.
